justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/output/FileWriterWithEncoding.java (384 lines) and src/test/java/org/apache/commons/io/output/FileWriterWithEncodingTest.java. The class has one cohesive responsibility: creating a Writer for a file with configurable encoding. Its public surface is mostly overloaded deprecated constructors that delegate to a single private initWriter(...) helper or the nested Builder, and the remaining logic is small construction/validation code plus a private OutputStreamWriter wrapper constructor. I do not see multiple substantial responsibilities, large method bodies, or a need to split the class into separate abstractions.
